finding: An approved plan could lose its only admission record when the chat session was replaced or deleted before the worker created a run.
fix: Migration 140 retains an independent scoped approval receipt. Claim and receipt commit in one transaction. Original-request recovery and duplicate checks consult that receipt. A duplicate receipt rolls back the attempted plan change; receipt-store failure also rolls back admission.

initial_failure.finding: After a replacement plan was stored, already_admitted returned false for the original request.

intermediate_results.finding: Parameterized tests reused request IDs in a module-scoped private DB; isolate their receipt table between test cases.
Packaging correctly rejected the new SQL file until it was git-tracked.
Two documentation paragraphs had fixed migration counts. Removed the count; preserved the historical test result.

upgrade: Fresh canonical migration and repeat apply pass. Populated upgrade preserves all prior snapshots including chat_sessions; the old approved plan is backfilled into exactly one receipt, without changing its session record. Receipt insertion failure and request reuse roll back the claim in private PostgreSQL.
checks: Ruff lint/format and diff checks pass; size caps unchanged.
limits: Migration 140 is required before admitting requests on this version. Only disposable databases were migrated. Preserved approval evidence is not execution/completion evidence and does not authorize automatic replay or prove orphaned-worker recovery. Full acceptance, live-provider performance, and application rollout/rollback remain open. No production deployment.
